hero_subhead: AGMs, product launches and town halls in a heritage theatre with a 16-foot video wall, wireless mics and seating for up to 100 — a room that makes your company look as good as the work.
band_intro: Most presentation venues are a projector in a beige room. Den 1880's Theatre was built the other way around: a 16-foot video wall, Sonos sound and wireless mics inside a heritage room with real character — so the space does some of the presenting for you.
spec_subhead: The screen, sound and seating are already in the room. Bring the slides.
cta_headline: Give The Big Update A Big Room
cta_subhead: Tell us your date, your headcount and what you're presenting. Our events team replies within one business day.
